topic: Human Digestive System Parts and Functions
key_concepts: The digestive system converts food into energy and basic nutrients for the body.
The digestive system consists of the gastrointestinal tract and accessory organs.

The small intestine has three parts: duodenum, jejunum, and ileum.

The mouth begins digestion through chewing and salivary enzymes.
The esophagus moves swallowed food to the stomach by peristalsis.
The stomach churns food in an acid bath and serves as a storage tank for food.
The small intestine is the main site of digestion and nutrient absorption.

The pancreas secretes enzymes that help digest carbohydrates, fats, and proteins.
